_doc: Phase 2 T-2.3 — 100-sample gold-label fixture for the Haiku LLM filter (Stage 2 detector). Each sample carries `expected` (gold-truth boolean: true = should admit as a question, false = should reject) + `haikuVerdict` (the deterministic single-line reply the mocked SDK returns, simulating what Haiku 4.5 would respond — `YES <reason>`, `NO <reason>`, or occasionally `MAYBE <reason>` for ambiguous cases). The fixture is hand-authored to encode realistic ~10-12 % Haiku-vs-gold disagreement so the AC gate (agreement ≥ 0.85) is meaningful — not a tautology. Distribution: 50 questions / 50 non-questions; EN qmark, EN wh-aux, EN modal, EN no-qmark, VI raw, VI stripped (no diacritics), VI có…không, VI đã…chưa, declarative-with-wh traps, embedded interrogatives, imperatives. AC: agreement ≥ 0.85 (per docs/IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md row T-2.3).
